title: Monthly cashflow
statementMd:
For each month show `income` (sum of deposits) and `outgoing` (sum of everything else, as a positive number) with the net difference, all rounded to 2 decimals. Earliest first.

Expected columns: `month`, `income`, `outgoing`, `net`.

Tables: `customers`, `accounts`, `transactions`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', tx_date) AS month, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'deposit' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS income, ROUND(-SUM(CASE WHEN kind <> 'deposit' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS outgoing, ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS net FROM transactions GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
